messages:
maria: Quick sync request from PM: they'd like a single "effective cost" metric that folds in cache savings + routing deltas. Q: show as main per-call column or keep token-level as default with a hover summary? :thinking:
jon: Hover-summary. per-call single number is handy but obscures where dollars come from. token breakdown is needed for debugging/chargebacks. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
alisha: PMs will want to see cost at-a-glance in the list. compromise: show effective_cost column but collapsed small, click to expand token + cache line items. :eyes:
sam: We must decide how to apportion batch/prefetch cache credits. Router currently applies credits at batch granularity. If we put credits into per-call effective_cost we need deterministic split or numbers will jitter.
evan: Proposal: effective_cost = raw_token_cost - apportioned_cache_credit + routing_delta. Apportion credits across calls in the same session window by token-length share (30m sliding window). deterministic and explainable.
maria: Add a "how we compute effective cost" link/modal. UX: default shows effective_cost; expanding shows token_cost, cache_credit, routing_delta and links to apportioning docs.
jon: API change: return both forms in usage row. example payload in logs: {effective_cost: 0.0123, token_cost: 0.0150, cache_credit: 0.0027, routing_delta: -0.0004}
alisha: field naming: backend prefers snake_case, frontend leans camelCase. let's normalize in the frontend and keep API snake_case. publish both in the spec if needed.
sam: perf note: computing apportionment for high-QPS sessions could be heavy. we should cap work with reservoir sampling for session buckets >N calls. tagging eng-infra.
evan: I'll draft apportioner with reservoir fallback and cold-start zeros. will include error bounds for sample-based split.
metric-bot: created metric econ.effective_cost.apportioned; alert: >3% diff vs token_cost over 5m.
maria: decisions: 1) show effective_cost column by default, collapse small; 2) API returns token + cache + routing + effective fields; 3) docs/modal with math and sampling caveats. action items: @evan apportioner draft, @sam infra scaling check, @alisha console mock, @jon api PR. :thumbsup:
jon: opening API PR now, will tag reviewers.
alisha: Figma mock tonight, will post in #eng-platform-design.
sam: scheduling perf test next week.
maria: thanks everyone. looping back after PR + mock. :rocket:
